name: Thoughtweft
description: A collective consciousness connecting Lorwyn kithkin by an empathic web.

description_citations.text: "Kithkin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Darial's last thoughts travel through the thoughtweft back to his doun.
timeline.quote: Their thoughtweft carried Darial's last thoughts back to his doun.

citation.text: Soul Reap (Eventide, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion, kithkin use the thoughtweft as a weapon until the Phyrexians exploit it, and many kithkin cut themselves off from it.
timeline.quote: Rather than suffer, many kithkin cut themselves off from the thoughtweft entirely.

citation.text: "Kithkin", section "Nomadic Kithkin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Kithkin minds are bound together by the thoughtweft.
relations.quote: They are mentally bound together by the magical thoughtweft.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

pages_say.description: The shared thought-bond that ties a kithkin clachan together.
